title: "Phase Transition" in fractional differential equations
summary: The basic result in the theory of linear ODEs is that the dimension of the fundamental set of linearly independent solutions is equal to the order of equation. This view is typically extended from integer-order to fractional differential equations. The purpose of this research is to demonstrate that this expectation is incorrect and explain why. We show that linear fractional differential equations may admit additional linearly independent solutions beyond their order.
